mentions.name: okular-mupdf-ng
mentions.description: This project hardens Linux document readers by sandboxing their most dangerous components, starting with Okular's document parser and renderer, to reduce the reader's attack surface.
mentions.problem: The parser and renderer of document readers like Okular are the most dangerous attack surface, exposing users to exploits from malicious documents.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a project to reduce attack surface of Linux document readers, starting with Okular: https://github.com/l4rzy/okular-mupdf-ng

The idea is to sandbox the most dangerous parts of it: The Document parser and renderer.
mentions.author: rzy
